product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - Non-Polarized NEMA 1-15P to Non-Polarized IEC 60320 C7 18AWG 7A/125V SPT‑2 10ft Black
product.description: Connect your battery chargers, laptop power supplies, AV equipment, video game consoles, and other equipment with non‑polarized IEC 60320 C8 power receptacle. This power cord features a non‑polarized IEC 60320 C7 plug on one end and a non‑polarized NEMA® 1‑15P 2‑prong plug on the other end. The C7 coupler is commonly known as a "figure‑8", "infinity", or "shotgun" plug, due to its shape.
